# DocumentTile

```ts
import { DocumentTile } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A file or generated document — a report, an export, an attachment, an upload. Use the tile layout in grids (3–4 columns with --space-500 gaps) where a preview helps people recognise the file, and the compact layout in lists, side panels, attachments, and upload results. Use Card for content that is not a file, and FileUpload for the drop zone that *starts* an upload.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'tile' \| 'compact'` | `'tile'` | Figma layout: tile is a card with a 160px thumbnail for grids; compact is a single row with a 40px icon block for lists, side panels, attachments, and upload results. Both stretch to their container. |
| `preview` | `'icon' \| 'photo'` | `'icon'` | Figma preview: icon shows the file-type icon on a neutral (tile) or tonal (compact) block; photo shows thumbnailSrc with the file-type icon as a small badge. Upload states always use icon. |
| `fileName` | `string` | **required** | File name (Figma fileName). Truncates to 2 lines (tile) or 1 (compact); the full name shows in a tooltip. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Secondary line, e.g. Modified 22 Jun 2026 · Sam Taylor (Figma meta). Hidden while an upload status is shown. |
| `tag` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional tag text rendered as a violet subtle Badge (Figma showTag, tile only). |
| `tagColor` | `BadgeColor` | `'violet'` | Badge color for tag. |
| `thumbnailSrc` | `string` | — | Photo preview URL for preview="photo". Decorative (alt=""): the file name names the tile. |
| `fileTypeIcon` | `React.ReactNode` | `<FileText />` | File-type glyph (Figma fileTypeIcon slot). Swap in an app icon (PDF, PowerPoint) when the product has one; it inherits color via currentColor. |
| `showThumbnail` | `boolean` | `true` | Hides the tile thumbnail for text-only grids (Figma showThumbnail). |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Selected treatment: 2px primary border, flat (Figma state=selected). Ignored during upload states. |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(selected: boolean) => void` | — | Renders a Checkbox for multi-select (Select <fileName>). Omit to show selection only visually via selected. |
| `status` | `'idle' \| 'uploading' \| 'uploaded' \| 'error'` | `'idle'` | Upload status. uploading shows a 4px progress bar with time left, % uploaded, and cancel; uploaded a full success bar with remove; error a full error bar with the message and retry. Replaces meta, download, and more while active. |
| `progress` | `number` | `0` | Upload progress 0–100 for status="uploading". |
| `timeLeft` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Time-left text beside the bar while uploading, e.g. 2 mins left. |
| `errorMessage` | `React.ReactNode` | `'Upload failed.'` | Error text for status="error". |
| `successMessage` | `React.ReactNode` | `'Uploaded successfully.'` | Success text for status="uploaded". |
| `href` | `string` | — | Makes the file name a link to the file; the whole tile is its click target. |
| `onOpen` | `() => void` | — | Makes the file name a button that opens the file (when there is no href). |
| `onDownload` | `() => void` | — | Shows the download action (Figma showDownload) and fires on click. |
| `menu` | `DocumentTileMenuItem[]` | — | Items for the More (⋮) menu. Omit to hide the menu button. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | — | Cancel action while uploading. |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` | — | Remove action once uploaded. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | — | Retry action after an error. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'onSelect'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<DocumentTile fileName="Q3 report.pdf" meta="Modified 22 Jun 2026 · Sam Taylor" href="/files/q3" />
<DocumentTile preview="photo" thumbnailSrc={src} fileName="Hero.png" tag="Image" onOpen={open} />
<DocumentTile layout="compact" fileName="Notes.docx" meta="12 KB" onDownload={download} menu={items} />
<DocumentTile selected onSelectedChange={setSelected} fileName="Deck.pptx" />
<DocumentTile layout="compact" status="uploading" progress={42} timeLeft="2 mins left" onCancel={cancel} fileName="Scan.pdf" />
<DocumentTile layout="compact" status="uploaded" onRemove={remove} fileName="Scan.pdf" />
<DocumentTile layout="compact" status="error" errorMessage="File is larger than 25 MB." onRetry={retry} fileName="Scan.pdf" />
<DocumentTile fileName="Budget.xlsx" fileTypeIcon={<SheetIcon />} />
```

## Accessibility

- The tile is named by its file name: the link or button wraps the visible name, so there is no separate aria-label to keep in sync. When the name is visually truncated, the full name is also shown in a SimpleTooltip on hover and focus.
- Actions are separate tab stops whose names include the file name ("Download Q3 report.pdf", "More actions for Q3 report.pdf", "Cancel upload of …"), so a list of tiles never produces a column of identical "Download" buttons.
- The upload bar is a Radix progressbar with aria-valuenow; a polite live region announces status changes (uploading, uploaded, failed) — never every percent tick.
- Errors pair the error color with an icon and text, never color alone.
- Photo previews are decorative (alt=""); the file-type badge is hidden from assistive tech because the file name already carries the extension.
- selected sets aria-current on the primary target; with onSelectedChange a real Checkbox ("Select …") carries the state.
- Focus is a 3px ring drawn outside the tile, so it never covers the preview.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the extension in fileName and put date, owner, or size in meta. | Put actions or links inside meta — use onDownload and menu. |
| Use compact for upload results and attachment lists. | Use tile for long lists — previews cost vertical space. |
| Pass timeLeft and onCancel while uploading. | Leave a failed upload without errorMessage and onRetry. |
| Swap fileTypeIcon for the product's app icon when there is one. | Rely on the photo alone to convey the file type. |
| Give every tile in a grid the same layout and preview mode. | Mix tile and compact layouts in one collection. |
